digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport / TicketTransport port
propositions: The DC transport is missing twelve members the core reaches for, so a writing reconcile pass fails, first surfacing as a crash on set_entity_property.
The dominant failure mode is silent degradation, not crashing, so 'no AttributeError' is the wrong acceptance bar and each member must be asserted present.

TicketTransport lacks @runtime_checkable and under-declares its members, so isinstance conformance and the contract suite passed against a transport that cannot complete a writing pass; a construction-time conformance guard must fire in the backend factories.
Each of the twelve members needs a recorded per-method verdict (implement via DC REST v2 / NotImplementedError / unreachable) because copying Cloud's endpoints and pagination breaks on DC.

set_reporter must write {'reporter':{'name':...}} and inbound_fields._identity_of must carry DC's name into account_id (accountId winning) or the reporter mutation re-emits forever, breaking idempotence.
Newly implemented members must log at WARNING naming the member and remote id, proven by a caplog test, because seven call sites swallow exceptions at every site.
